message.content:
Velvet one-shoulder sheath dress, floor-length silhouette in deep emerald green (#0a3d2e), silk-crepe blend.
Strappy pointed-toe pump, mid-calf height in polished gold (#c5a059), suede with metal hardware.
Pearl drop earrings, 6 cm length, cultured freshwater pearl and 18k white gold setting.

This outfit strikes the perfect balance between elegant celebration attire and autumnal warmth, suitable for an upscale restaurant setting where frost may be lingering outside but warmth is inside. The rich emerald velvet provides a luxurious texture that stands out against skin tones while adhering to the requested formal or smart dress code without being overly restrictive. The gold accents echo the festive lighting of a holiday party, and the one-shoulder cut offers a modern, flattering silhouette for any body shape.
